additional_review_finding.finding: Guarding every session prevented busy session A from reclaiming unrelated finished VM B, including low-disk child creation. Duplicate target ownership was also not rejected.
additional_review_finding.fix: Lease only the exact candidate owner; refuse ambiguous or malformed ownership. Shared lifecycle lock still serializes child registration/deletion.

ownership_refusal_scope: Invalid JSON, missing/non-string/malformed task identifiers, and duplicate sessions claiming the target. This is not an assertion of full session-record schema validation.

corruption_fix.design: Preserve existing independently valid stopped-verification local disposal rule. Unknown owner/child metadata retains development/legacy tasks. No ownership index, migration, new authority or schema.
corruption_fix.reporting: kept tasks and content-free record issue categories; corrupt records retained
corruption_fix.coverage: Invalid JSON, null/scalar/list, missing identity, symlinked files/directories, late corruption, low-disk verification-child creation, and all prior stale-plan/owner/child/probe/fingerprint cases.
corruption_fix.atomic_write_context: Existing atomic replacement/fsync tests pass; ordinary interrupted writes producing partial final JSON were not established. Corruption handling is still required for preexisting/damaged metadata.
corruption_fix.residual_policy: This provides partial availability, not automatic deletion of development VMs with unknown ownership. If only uncertain development VMs remain and disk is low, creation still fails closed.
